name: UnSub (Chinese-speaking retail-skimmer operator, Strix/Cairn/Hermes) — Gambit Security
akas: UnSub (no designation; "Chinese-speaking, financially motivated" per Gambit)
brief: Gambit Security recovered the operator's staging server and documented an ongoing campaign in which three open-source AI harnesses automated nearly the whole intrusion chain against hundreds of online retailers to plant payment-card skimmers: Strix for vulnerability discovery (146 deep-mode runs against 138 hosts), Cairn for autonomous exploitation, and the Hermes orchestration console (121 skills, 78 attack-oriented) driving frontier and open-weight models via OpenRouter. Exploitation included unauthenticated SQLi, MFA bypass, file-upload RCE, sudo/NFS misconfiguration abuse and cloud-secret harvesting, followed by skimmer injection, cron persistence and database wipes. Gambit confirmed 19 victims and 100+ further infected sites. *Analyst note: interim report from a vendor; actor unnamed; Security.io rates its own confidence medium because some conclusions rest on agent-generated logs. Tool overlap (Strix) with the GTIG PRC-nexus row is not evidence of the same actor.* Gambit Security
